flow.name: order-status-api-main
flow.doc:description: Listens on /api/order-status/*, routes to the implementation flow and answers the router's own errors in the shared error body.

apikit:router.doc:name: Route by the order status spec

set-payload.doc:name: Build the 400 body
set-payload.value: #[output application/json --- { error: { code: 400, reason: "Bad Request", message: "The request is invalid." } }]

set-payload.doc:name: Build the 404 body
set-payload.value: #[output application/json --- { error: { code: 404, reason: "Not Found", message: "The requested API endpoint does not exist." } }]

set-payload.doc:name: Build the 405 body
set-payload.value: #[output application/json --- { error: { code: 405, reason: "Method Not Allowed", message: "The method is not allowed for this endpoint." } }]

set-payload.doc:name: Build the 406 body
set-payload.value: #[output application/json --- { error: { code: 406, reason: "Not Acceptable", message: "No acceptable representation is available." } }]

set-payload.doc:name: Build the 415 body
set-payload.value: #[output application/json --- { error: { code: 415, reason: "Unsupported Media Type", message: "The request media type is not supported." } }]

set-payload.doc:name: Build the 500 body
set-payload.value: #[output application/json --- { error: { code: 500, reason: "Internal Server Error", message: "An internal error occurred." } }]

flow.name: get:\orders\(orderId):order-status-api-config
flow.doc:description: APIkit implementation flow of GET /orders/{orderId}: keeps the order id and the correlation id, then hands over to order-status-handler.

sub-flow.name: order-status-handler
sub-flow.doc:description: Runs order-status-process and turns each failure into the status and the shared error body of the contract; called by the implementation flow.

logger.doc:name: Log the entry
logger.message: #[output text/plain --- write({ event: 'order-status.entry', correlationId: vars.effectiveCorrelationId, orderId: vars.orderId }, 'application/json', { indent: false })]

on-error-continue.doc:name: On order unknown to the Order Store

set-payload.doc:name: Build the 404 body
set-payload.value: #[output application/json --- { error: { code: 404, reason: "Not Found", message: "The order was not found." } }]

set-payload.doc:name: Build the 504 body
set-payload.value: #[output application/json --- { error: { code: 504, reason: "Gateway Timeout", message: "The Order Store did not answer in time." } }]

set-payload.doc:name: Build the 503 body
set-payload.value: #[output application/json --- { error: { code: 503, reason: "Service Unavailable", message: "The Order Store cannot be reached." } }]

set-payload.doc:name: Build the 502 body
set-payload.value: #[output application/json --- { error: { code: 502, reason: "Bad Gateway", message: "The Order Store failed or returned an unexpected answer." } }]

logger.doc:name: Log the exit
logger.message: #[output text/plain --- write({ event: 'order-status.exit', correlationId: vars.effectiveCorrelationId, orderId: vars.orderId, status: vars.httpStatus }, 'application/json', { indent: false })]

sub-flow.name: order-status-log-error
sub-flow.doc:description: Logs one structured error entry with the correlation id and the error type, never the error description or a payload; called from the error handlers.

logger.doc:name: Log the error entry
logger.message: #[output text/plain --- write({ event: 'order-status.error', correlationId: vars.effectiveCorrelationId default correlationId, orderId: vars.orderId, errorType: (error.errorType.namespace default '') ++ ':' ++ (error.errorType.identifier default '') }, 'application/json', { indent: false })]

sub-flow.name: order-status-process
sub-flow.doc:description: Reads the order, checks the Order Store's own rules, reads each distinct product once inside the request budget and builds the response; called by order-status-handler.

set-variable.doc:name: Set the request deadline
set-variable.value: #[output application/java --- vars.deadlineMillis default ((now() as Number {unit: 'milliseconds'}) + (p('orderStatus.budgetMillis') as Number))]

flow-ref.name: order-status-check-deadline
flow-ref.doc:name: Check the deadline before the order call

choice.doc:name: Check the order against the Order Store rules

raise-error.description: The order has more lines than the Order Store allows
raise-error.doc:name: Raise too many lines

raise-error.description: The Order Store sent an unknown status code
raise-error.doc:name: Raise unknown status code

choice.doc:name: Read the products only when there are any

sub-flow.name: order-status-get-order
sub-flow.doc:description: Calls GET /orders/{orderId} on the Order Store; its failures (404, timeout, connectivity) reach order-status-handler as HTTP errors; called by order-status-process.

http:request.doc:name: Get order from the Order Store

sub-flow.name: order-status-read-products
sub-flow.doc:description: Reads each distinct product once, in parallel up to a set number at once, and fails the request with the most telling error when a read fails; called by order-status-process.

flow-ref.name: order-status-check-deadline
flow-ref.doc:name: Check the deadline before the product call

set-payload.value: #[output application/java --- { ok: true, productId: vars.productId, productName: payload.name default null }]
set-payload.doc:name: Report the product name

set-payload.value: #[output application/java --- { ok: false, productId: vars.productId, errorType: (error.errorType.namespace default '') ++ ':' ++ (error.errorType.identifier default '') }]
set-payload.doc:name: Report the failure type

choice.doc:name: Map a failed product read to one error

raise-error.description: The Order Store did not answer a product read in time
raise-error.doc:name: Raise Order Store timeout

raise-error.description: The Order Store cannot be reached for a product read
raise-error.doc:name: Raise Order Store unavailable

set-variable.doc:name: Keep the product names by id

sub-flow.name: order-status-get-product
sub-flow.doc:description: Calls GET /products/{productId} on the Order Store; a product it does not know gives a null name, any other failure propagates to the route; called by each route of order-status-read-products.

try.doc:name: Call the Order Store for the product

http:request.doc:name: Get product from the Order Store

on-error-continue.doc:name: On product unknown to the Order Store

on-error-propagate.doc:name: On any other Order Store failure

sub-flow.name: order-status-check-deadline
sub-flow.doc:description: Raises the budget error when the request's deadline has passed, so no further Order Store call starts; called before every Order Store call.

raise-error.description: The request's time budget is spent
raise-error.doc:name: Raise budget exceeded
